fields.name: stars
fields.remark: 五星展示态（满分 10，半星步进 1）
fields.computeBody:
var score = Number($props.value)
if (!(score >= 0)) score = 0
if (score > 10) score = 10
var size = Number($props.size)
if (!(size > 0)) size = 22
var allowHalf = $props.allowHalf !== false
var activeColor = $props.activeColor || '#f7ba2a'
if (typeof $color !== 'undefined' && $color && $color[activeColor]) activeColor = $color[activeColor]
var inactiveColor = $props.inactiveColor || '#c0c4cc'
if (typeof $color !== 'undefined' && $color && $color[inactiveColor]) inactiveColor = $color[inactiveColor]
var list = []
for (var i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
  var full = i * 2
  var half = full - 1
  var fill = 'empty'
  if (score >= full) fill = 'full'
  else if (score >= half) fill = 'half'
  var clipWidth = fill === 'full' ? size : fill === 'half' ? size / 2 : 0
  list.push({
    index: i,
    fill: fill,
    clipWidth: clipWidth,
    halfSize: size / 2,
    size: size,
    leftValue: allowHalf ? half : full,
    rightValue: full,
    activeColor: activeColor,
    inactiveColor: inactiveColor
  })
}
return list
